description: In a nonempty dense linear order without endpoints, \(\exists x\;(C\land\bigwedge_{\ell\in L}\ell<x\land\bigwedge_{u\in U}x<u)\) is equivalent to \(C\land\bigwedge_{\ell\in L,u\in U}\ell<u\), for finite \(L,U\) and a condition \(C\) independent of \(x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.dlo_clause_elimination.{u} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M] [DenselyOrdered M]
  [NoMinOrder M] [NoMaxOrder M] [Nonempty M] (l u : Finset M) (C : Prop) :
  (∃ x, C ∧ (∀ a ∈ l, a < x) ∧ ∀ b ∈ u, x < b) ↔ C ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ u, a < b
